en: A commercial postcard front showing a colorful historic square with ornate buildings, a tall clock tower, and a large baroque-style column monument with statues. The right half of the front is a grey design panel with printed text indicating it is a Pécs postcard collection by Ars Una Studio. The back side is a standard unused postcard layout with space for a message and address, marked with the city name Pécs and publisher details.
